items.text: Cincinnati (Madrid game): DNP Wed/Thu - CB DJ Turner II (heel; full participant per Thursday reports), S Kyle Dugger (quad), DE Cedric Johnson (ankle/foot), DT Jonathan Allen (rest); S Jordan Battle (hamstring) limited. DE Cashius Howell on IR; TE Erick All Jr. out for season.
